newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B index ends down on correction.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B index ends down on correction.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index ended down in slow trade on Friday on a technical correction after gains in the past four days, with investors cautious about unpromising company results, brokers said.
The B share index fell 0.337 points or 0.46 percent to 72.936 points on volume of 14.8 million shares worth $6.3 million compared with $11.1 million on Thursday.

Brokers said that domestic investors were not satisfied with the dividend plan of Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development despite a surge in its net profit, and this led to falls in Pudong shares and the index.
Shanghai Jinqiao was the biggest loser in both the A and B share markets.
Its B share fell $0.02 or 3.44 percent to $0.56 on volume of 432,400 shares and its A share was down 1.13 yuan or 6.5 percent to 16.23 yuan on volume of 3.6 million shares.
"After consecutive rises in the past few days, the market experienced a technical correction with a little profit-taking, but market sentiment remained good," one broker said.
"The index will rise further after the correction as the market fundamentals have improved a lot despite some firms posting unpromising 1996 reuslts," a second broker said.
Of 43 B shares, 39 traded with 14 down, 10 flat and 15 up.

Toy maker Shanghai Haixin traded the most on active buying encouraged by its good 1996 results and offering plan, brokers said. It rose $0.008 or 1.25 percent to $0.644 on volume of 1.8 million shares.

Haixin's 1996 net profit was 75.139 million yuan ($9.07 million), up 53.81 percent from 48.851 million yuan in 1995 on international standards due to good management which guaranteed sales and quality, its annual report said on Friday.
Shanghai's A share index edged down on a technical correction with speculative funds leaving for the primary market, brokers said.
There were four new A shares issued in both Shanghai and Shenzhen.
The index slipped 12.295 points or 0.97 percent to 1,259.317 points on volume of 714.7 million shares worth 8.3 billion yuan.
The SSE 30 blue chip index fell 34.835 points or 1.02 percent to 3,384.134 points.
